Every historical chart and photograph reproduced in this book is sourced from Wikimedia Commons under a Creative Commons or public-domain license. This page collects the source, author, and license for each one, so the chapters themselves can stay focused on the ideas.

Diagrams *without* an entry below — the flowcharts, anatomy diagrams, and pipeline illustrations throughout the book — were built by hand for this book and need no external credit.
